findings.body: The Claude worker still advertises only MCP and callable-agent names. New sibling-path evidence: its real query mounts `capabilities.availableTools` in `apps/core/src/adapters/llm/anthropic-claude-agent/runner/query-loop-phases-setup.ts:443`. Those include native implementations of Gantry public WebSearch, WebRead, File* and RunCommand tools, as mapped in `apps/core/src/shared/gantry-tool-facades.ts:126`. For example, WebSearch and WebFetch are mounted by default but absent from this inventory. Unlike the DeepAgents worker, the Claude worker never finalizes availability from that complete mounting selection. This leaves the Done-when requirement unmet and can still make the agent report available web/file capabilities as absent.

findings.body: The Claude expectation compares the compiled prompt exclusively with the Gantry stdio server's registrations. It excludes the public capabilities implemented by the native tools that the real worker passes through `options.tools` (`apps/core/src/adapters/llm/anthropic-claude-agent/runner/query-loop-phases-setup.ts:443`). Consequently, all six cases pass while mounted WebSearch/WebRead/File* and RunCommand projections remain absent from Claude's advertised inventory. The WebSearch/FileRead/RunCommand assertions earlier in this test inspect only DeepAgents. Extend the Claude runner-boundary proof to compare final model instructions with the complete exposed surface, using the public-name mapping; the proof-list claim of agreement with actual mounts is currently incomplete.
